column1: # Unreal: nninitStartup reserves a 62 GB address region and its FMallocBinned3 takes 37 GB of it, so a 64 GB alias region for the bring-up on the Mac. The rewriter cuts the allocator in any Unreal 4 / 5 main (dm/tools/ue_malloc.py) and gives the region what the alias region has room for (dm/tools/ue_region.py), so an iPhone takes a smaller guest block, as Octopath Traveler 0's profile (docs/reference/memory.md)
